# FDG4023

> DO provide at least one type that is an implementation of an interface.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.6 Interface Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: the implementation can ship in another assembly of the framework, which one compilation cannot see.

## From the book

Doing this helps to validate the design of the interface. For example, `System.Collections.Generic.List<T>` is an implementation of the `System.Collections.Generic.IList<T>` interface.
